question:
A dice has its faces marked by letters B, G, N, E, I and L. Two positions of the same dice are shown in the given figures. Which face is opposite to face B?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68cf28c4602d62622a1b97f2f2a322a5a26cedc43f23234e75a822d72b7ed665.png]
solution:
Given dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8245121b4999d7d5bd2c5cae18fc849be0744c1cfea1c074a29ebd4dd065951.png] 

As, E is common in both the dice. moving clockwise direction from E.

Opposite pair

N ⇔ L

G ⇔ I

E ⇔ B

Thus, B is opposite to E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
